_comment: WhatsApp message templates (Meta format). The single source of truth for the Worker (names, parameter counts), the fake WhatsApp (validation) and scripts/setup/whatsapp-templates.mjs (creation at Meta). {{PANEL_URL}} is replaced by the deployment's panel URL when the templates are created: the buttons open the panel, they never act on an order. No customer data in any parameter.
